standard.summary: 训练量化类型（别名） 可选值（含换档影响）。 真正的 FP4 开关是独立字段 bnb_4bit_quant_type，不在本字段的可选值里。
standard.effect: 枚举切换会改变算法或资源行为。
standard.avoidWhen: 未理解影响前不要叠多个激进档。

standard_en.summary: Training quantization type (an alias); the values below include what changing gear does. The real FP4 switch is a separate field, bnb_4bit_quant_type, which is not among this field's values.
standard_en.effect: Switching the enum changes algorithm or resource behaviour.
standard_en.whenToUse: Prefer the default and switch only after a short test.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Do not stack several aggressive gears before you understand the effect.

optionDescriptions.qlora_nf4: QLoRA NF4 on the training side.
